text:
Maya: Quick sync — prepping AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace onboarding. Need clarity on procurement SKUs, metering IDs, and contract clause around data residency. cc @jon_legal
Tyler: For infra, we need the exact meter ID formats so we can wire them into billing export. AWS uses `sku-xxxx`, GCP uses `projects/*/services/*`, azure is a GUID?
Maya: Right. Jon, can you confirm the legal wording we should hand to partners for trials and data residency?
jon_legal: Short answer: need a clause for 'transient telemetry' + explicit region-binding for Private deployments. I'll share a draft by EOD. Also we should avoid phrasing that implies us hosting customer data in multi-tenant pools.
Anita_aws: AWS marketplace team flagged that our offer needs these fields in the manifest: `productCode`, `pricingDimension`, `meteringId`. They expect monthly SKU mapping and an entitlement ID for trials.
leo_gcp: GCP wants a CSV mapping: internal SKU -> GCP product SKU -> pricing unit. Also confirm whether trial is usage-limited or time-limited. That affects their free-trial taxonomy.
Sarah: Product ask: for trial we prefer usage-limited (1000 inference units) rather than time-limited. Much easier for our metering and cheaper for customers. Is that ok legal/partner side?
jon_legal: Usage-limited is fine. Need a short TOS addendum that defines 'inference unit' and caps. I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum we can push to the marketplaces.
Tyler: From engineering: once we have the SKU mapping I can add transform to our billing pipeline. Suggest we version the mapping file as `marketplace/mapping-v1.csv` in the repo.
Maya: Good. Who owns final manifest upload for each cloud? We should avoid duplicate effort.
Anita_aws: I'll take AWS listing upload (coordinate with AWS PM). Will need final asset bundle + 3 logos (512x512, svg, screenshot).
leo_gcp: I'll coordinate GCP listing. Quick question: do we want 'private offer' for enterprise or public listing first?
Sarah: Public listing first to capture self-serve, private offer later for enterprise contracts.
ops-bot: Reminder: run the preflight checklist: `./scripts/marketplace_preflight.sh --cloud all` before upload. See docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/marketplace/preflight
Maya: Action items: Jon -> add addendum draft by EOD; Anita -> AWS manifest template by tomorrow; Leo -> GCP CSV schema by tomorrow; Tyler -> prepare billing ingest code stub once mapping exists. I'll assemble asset bundle and screenshots.
Tyler: Ping me when CSV is ready, I'll mock a mapping and validate webhook->billing flow.
jon_legal: Pushing draft to drive: https://drive.redwood/legal/marketplace-addendum. Feedback welcome.
Maya: Thanks — will loop in sales for pricing tiers once mapping is stable. :thumbsup:
